12301.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance to the Warded Castle.

12301.description:
The gallery curves along the foot of the castle's outer wall, a vaulted
passage with a floor of wide, worn flagstones. Ward-sigils glow faintly
in the stone at head height, humming a note too low to hear and just
loud enough to feel in the teeth. Arrow slits pierce the outer wall at
long intervals, admitting only a thin, colourless gleam. Westward the
gallery returns to the castle entrance, and it goes on east around the
wall.

12302.name: Entrance to the Warded Castle

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Gatehouse.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

south.description: To the south lies A Hidden Room.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

up.description: To the up lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

12302.description:
The gallery meets the castle's gate passage in a vaulted vestibule, its
ceiling grooved with the iron tracks of a portcullis rusted fast in the
raised position. A massive ward-stone set in the wall glows with a
steady blue light, the source of the humming that fills the whole
castle. In the south wall a door is fitted so finely to the stonework
that you nearly miss it. The gatehouse stands ahead to the north, and
the gallery runs away east and west.

extra_descs.ward-stone stone ward:
The ward-stone is a block of blue-veined rock as tall as a man, set deep
in the wall and warm to the touch. Its glow dims for a heartbeat
whenever something in the castle tries to die, and then it burns
brighter.

12303.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies Entrance to the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

12303.description:
The gallery runs out from the entrance toward the sealed side of the
castle, its flagstones darker and colder than elsewhere. Sconces here
hold the stubs of candles that have never been lit, and a thin film of
dust lies unbroken. A faint scrabbling sounds from the wall, as of nails
on stone. East lies the entrance, and the gallery goes on west.

12304.name: A Hidden Room

north.description: To the north lies Entrance to the Warded Castle.

12304.description:
A hidden room tucked behind the gate wall, little bigger than a closet,
with a cot, a table and shelves of rolled maps. A ward-sigil on the door
glows green for friends and red for foes. Rations in a tin box have
turned to dust, and a message is scratched into the wall above the cot.
The door north leads out to the castle entrance.

12305.name: Inside the Gatehouse

north.description: To the north lies On the Castle Grounds.

east.description: To the east lies A Grey Room.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance to the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies A White Room.

12305.description:
The gatehouse is a squat, thick-walled passage pierced by murder-holes
in its ceiling and lined with niches where the garrison once kept watch.
The great winch for the portcullis crouches against one wall, its chain
hanging slack and green with verdigris. Two doors face one another
across the passage, one painted a dull grey and one a chalky white, both
banded with ward-sigils. The castle grounds open north, and the entrance
lies south.

12306.name: On the Castle Grounds

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To The Keep.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Gatehouse.

west.description: To the west lies Servants Quarters.

12306.description:
Beyond the gate lies a wide paved yard, roofed by a lid of pale ward-
light that hangs overhead like breath on a window. A well with a rotted
windlass squats in its centre, its rim ringed with boot-scuffs. Paths
run north toward the keep, east to a stable, and west to a low range of
servants' quarters. The gatehouse lies back south.

extra_descs.well windlass:
The well is stopped with a round slab of stone, and scratches around the
slab suggest it was shut from within. Faint knocking sometimes comes up
through the rock.

12307.name: A White Room

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Gatehouse.

12307.description:
A chamber of chalk-white stone, bare except for a single circle of runes
cut in the floor and glowing with a steady light. The air is warm and
smells faintly of lilies. The door by which you came has sealed so
completely that it might never have been. The hum of the wards here is
gentle, almost kind, and it makes you want to sit down.

12308.name: A Grey Room

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Gatehouse.

12308.description:
The walls of this grey chamber are lined with slate, cold and damp, and
a cold mist seems to hang just above the floor. The ward-sigils here are
carved deep and filled with lead, and they make a slow, grinding hum. No
door shows on any wall, only seamless slate. The silence presses on your
ears like deep water.

12309.name: Servants Quarters

north.description: To the north lies Servants Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies On the Castle Grounds.

west.description: To the west lies Servants Quarters.

12309.description:
Narrow bunks fill this servants' room in three tiers, the straw spilled
from the mattresses and trampled flat. A shrine to a household saint, a
clay figure with a chipped nose, sits in a niche, a dry wick before it.
Mouse-gnawed aprons hang from the door. The room opens north onto the
quarters' passage, east to the castle grounds, and west to more bunks.

12310.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Stable.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies On the Castle Grounds.

12310.description:
The stable's front bay is a high-roofed barn where carts once stood,
with great doors that hang half open and will not close. Drifts of dust
and chaff lie against the walls. A weathervane tinkles faintly somewhere
overhead, in a place where no wind blows. The bay leads north to the
yard and east deeper into the stalls, and west the doors open on the
castle grounds.

12311.name: Servants Quarters

north.description: To the north lies Servants Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies Servants Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Mushroom Farm.

12311.description:
A damp, low room where the servants kept their trunks, their lids
propped open on tangles of mouldering rags. A smell of earth and fungus
drifts in from the west, rich and wet and out of place in a stone house.
A candle-stub burns on a ledge, a flame the colour of milk. Passages
lead north and east, and an opening west drops toward the farm.

12312.name: The Mushroom Farm

north.description: To the north lies The Mushroom Farm.

east.description: To the east lies Servants Quarters.

12312.description:
The farm's far end is a damp cavern with a ceiling too low to stand
under, dripping steadily into pools ringed with fungus. Giant mushrooms
as tall as a man stand in the dark, their caps glowing a faint, sickly
green. Rough ladders and baskets rot where they were left. The cave goes
north, and an opening east leads up toward the servants' rooms.

12313.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Stable.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Stable.

12313.description:
A farrier's corner of the stable: a tilted anvil, a sack of nails, a
hoof-rasp hung on a peg. Horseshoes nailed over the door have turned
black. The floor is trodden to a hard, polished earth. Passages lead
north, east to the stalls' end, and west toward the castle grounds.

12314.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Stable.

12314.description:
The end of the stable is a dead-end corner of stalls, with a hayloft
ladder lashed to the beam. Spilled oats have sprouted a pale fur of
mould. A water trough, dry and cracked, rests against a post. The stable
goes north from here, or west along the row.

12315.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Stable.

12315.description:
Wide stalls line this part of the stable, divided by planks chewed and
kicked ragged. Straw lies in each, bleached grey and never changed. A
mounting block stands by the door with an iron ring set in the wall
above it. Doors lead north into the workshop, west along the stalls, and
south to a farther corner.

12316.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Workshop.

12316.description:
Harness-makers' tools litter this end of the workshop: awls, stitching
clamps and a barrel of rotted rivets. Saddle-trees hang from the ceiling
like the ribs of beasts. A smell of leather and horse sweat comes up
from the stable. The workshop goes north, a doorway south opens into the
stable, and the benches continue west.

12317.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Workshop.

12317.description:
Grindstones and whetting wheels crowd this part of the workshop, their
rims worn thin, and a trough of black water stands beside them. Blades
in every stage of repair lie on the benches, edges blunt, as if the
smith was called away mid-stroke. A great vice is bolted to a post.
Aisles lead north and south, and open west.

12318.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Guards Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Workshop.

12318.description:
A long workbench runs under hanging tools, hammers, tongs and files, all
bright with oil that never dries. A forge sits cold in the corner, its
bellows slack and cracked, with sparks of blue ward-light flickering
where the coals should be. Racks of half-finished helms line one wall. A
doorway north leads to the barracks, the workshop goes on south, and a
passage opens west.

12319.name: The Guards Quarters

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Guards Quarters.

12319.description:
A cramped corner of the barracks holds the captain's cot behind a
hanging curtain, with a locker beside it. A cracked mirror and a dented
dress helm catch the pale light on a shelf. The beam above the cot bears
a hundred nicks, one for every year of the curse. A doorway south leads
to the workshop, and the barracks lies west.

12320.name: The Guards Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Guards Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Guards Quarters.

12320.description:
The barracks room is dominated by a long table where the garrison's
rolls were kept, a black ledger still open upon it and the ink dried to
brown dust. Names fill the pages, each with a notch cut beside it for
every death that did not take. Wards glow along the beams. East the
barracks goes on, south a doorway leads to a workshop, and west is the
long hall.

12321.name: The Guards Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Guards Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To The Keep.

12321.description:
A long barracks hall opens here, with rows of bunks built in tiers
against the walls and a table scarred by dagger-play. The bunks are
neatly made, the blankets stiff and grey, as if the sleepers might be
called at any hour. A rack of spears runs along one wall, all of them
pitted with rust. The hall goes on east, an archway opens south to the
ward, and a door leads west to the keep's pathway.

12322.name: Pathway To The Keep

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

east.description: To the east lies The Guards Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Gallows.

12322.description:
The pathway ends at the foot of the keep, whose enormous walls rise
sheer into the glowing ward-light. A great arched doorway yawns north,
its oak doors long since torn from their hinges and leaned against the
stone. To the east a doorway marked with a crossed-swords plaque leads
to the guards' quarters, and to the west a broad arch opens on the
gallows court. The inner ward lies back south.

12323.name: The Gallows

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To The Keep.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Gallows.

12323.description:
A massive timber beam spans the vault, and from it hang three nooses of
weathered rope that turn slowly in no wind. Beneath it stands a platform
of warped black planks with a trapdoor, its hinge-pins rusted. Ward-
sigils are scratched into the beam, deep, as if a prisoner had tried to
mark his own end. The gallows court goes on west, the pathway lies east,
and a passage leads south to the ward.

extra_descs.beam nooses gallows:
The nooses are knotted with the care of an expert and never frayed. When
one swings in your direction the rope seems to tighten expectantly.

12324.name: The Gallows

east.description: To the east lies The Gallows.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

west.description: To the west lies The Gallows.

12324.description:
A raised dais of grey stone stands against the wall of this hall, with a
lectern for the reading of sentences and a bench for the condemned.
Ropes coil on iron pegs, hung in neat loops. A smell of damp hemp and
cold iron is all about. The hall runs east to the gibbet and west to the
stocks, and a door south leads into the kitchen.

12325.name: The Gallows

east.description: To the east lies The Gallows.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

12325.description:
Wooden stocks and a whipping post stand in this corner, their wood
polished by those who were fastened in them. A cage of rusted bars, hung
from a chain, dangles with its door ajar. The scratches on the floor
beneath it make a pattern like frantic handwriting. The hall opens east,
and a narrow door south leads into the kitchen.

12326.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Gallows.

east.description: To the east lies The Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

12326.description:
Hams hang in a row from the beams, shrivelled to leather and strung with
dusty webs. Barrels of salt pork and pickling brine stand with their
lids split, and shelves hold stoppered jars of unknown dark stuff. A
door in the north wall leads to the gallows hall, the kitchen opens east
and south.

12327.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies The Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

12327.description:
Stone shelves hold row upon row of earthenware crocks, glazed in blue
and cracked, their contents turned to varnish. A mortar the size of a
bucket stands on a block with its pestle laid across it. The wards hum
thinly in the corners. The kitchen runs north, east and south from here.

12328.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies The Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies The Mushroom Farm.

12328.description:
A scullery of low sinks and drainboards, the stone worn into smooth
hollows, and a hand-pump whose handle has rusted off. Pale roots have
crept in at the corner of the floor, thin as hair, and a damp cool
breath rises from below. Mushrooms have started in the cracks. The
kitchen goes north and east, and a stair of worn steps leads south
toward the farm.

12329.name: The Mushroom Farm

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies Servants Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Mushroom Farm.

12329.description:
The farm is a low rough chamber cut into raw rock, its floor heaped with
beds of black compost where pale mushrooms grow in crowded rows. Water
seeps down the walls and gathers in channels worn by many hands. The air
is thick with spores and a rich, sweet smell of rot, and the ward-hum is
muffled by the stone. A stair leads north to the kitchen, an opening
east gives onto the servants' quarters, and the cavern runs on south.

extra_descs.mushrooms beds compost:
The mushrooms are fat and pale, with gills that glimmer green at the
edges. Some of the beds are packed with something that was once a man,
and the caps have grown through the cloth.

12330.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Gallows.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12330.description:
Roasting spits and a huge open hearth dominate the corner of the
kitchen, with a spit rod still fixed across the andirons. Ladles and
skimmers dangle from hooks above a stone sink, rimed with salt. A
grating in the floor breathes the cool smell of the cellar. Passages
lead north to the gallows court, south and west within the kitchen, and
east to the ward.

12331.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Kitchen.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12331.description:
A great bread oven fills the wall of this part of the kitchen, its iron
door hanging open on a cavity of cold black ash. Flour sacks sag against
the wall, split and spilled in a pale spreading drift. The smell of
ancient yeast is dizzying. The kitchen runs north, south and west, and a
doorway east leads out to the ward.

12332.name: Servants Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies Servants Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies Servants Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Mushroom Farm.

12332.description:
A crowded, comfortless dormitory where the cooks and scullions slept,
with cots stacked to the ceiling and a washstand cracked clean through.
Pale threads of mould have crept over the cots and ripened into small
white caps. A narrow door north leads to the kitchen, and the quarters
go on east and south, with a damp passage opening west.

12333.name: The Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies Servants Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12333.description:
The kitchen's long scrubbed table runs the length of the room, its top
gouged where meat was chopped, a heavy cleaver left stuck upright in the
wood. Copper pans hang from a rack, green and dull, and a cauldron of
congealed grey porridge sits on the cold hearth. The kitchen goes north
and west, a doorway east opens to the ward, and a door south leads to
the quarters.

12334.name: Servants Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To The Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Servants Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies Servants Quarters.

12334.description:
A long passage between narrow rooms serves as the servants' hall, its
walls hung with pegs and little shelves, each marked with a faded tag in
a careful hand. A bench runs the length of it, worn by the sitting of
tired people. The sound of far-off scrubbing seems to follow you. Doors
lead north to the ward, east to the pathway, and south and west along
the quarters.

12335.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies Servants Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12335.description:
A chopping block gashed by a thousand cleaver strokes sits beside a
stack of firewood, split and neatly piled and long gone to punk. A
rusted pair of iron tongs hangs from a hook on the kitchen wall. The
wards hum a little lower here, comfortable as a hearth. The ward goes
north and east, the kitchen opens west, and a doorway south leads to the
servants' quarters.

12336.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Centre Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12336.description:
A rain-barrel stands against a post, its staves split and dry, and a
washing-line hangs across the court strung with grey shirts as stiff as
boards. The paving is stained in a wide, pale ring where something was
scrubbed again and again. Faint clinking of pots seems to come from the
kitchen door to the west. The centre ward lies east, the ward runs north
and south.

12337.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Gallows.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

12337.description:
A stretch of the ward is cobbled here in round river-stones, slick and
dark though nothing drips. The smell of tallow and boiled cabbage drifts
from the kitchen door to the west, thick enough to taste. Overhead the
ward-light flickers and steadies, flickers and steadies, like a lamp in
a draught. The gallows court lies north, the ward goes on east and
south, and the kitchen opens west.

12338.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To The Keep.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Centre Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12338.description:
Straw archery butts stand against a wall, still bristling with arrows
whose feathers have rotted away. The wards flicker above, flaring
whenever a dry draught crosses the court. A stone trough, green and
empty, rests beside a post worn smooth by leaning backs. The pathway to
the keep runs north from here, the ward's centre lies south, and
passages lead east and west.

12339.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Guards Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12339.description:
This part of the Inner Ward is lined with kennels of stone, long empty,
and a drill post pocked by countless sword cuts. The paving is cracked
and scorched where something once fell from the keep. A thin line of
blue light runs along the wall and loses itself in the dark. A doorway
north leads to the barracks, the workshop lies east, and the ward
continues south and west.

12340.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Guards Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12340.description:
Racks of lances and polearms stand in this corner of the workshop
awaiting new heads, with a stack of hafts beside them gone grey and
brittle. A fine layer of metal filings coats the floor and crunches
faintly underfoot. A rope pull dangles from a bell that has no clapper.
A doorway north leads to the barracks, and aisles run east and south,
with an opening west to the ward.

12341.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Workshop.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12341.description:
A carpenter's corner: shavings piled in drifts, a half-built siege
ladder, saw-horses, and a rack of chisels. The smell of sawdust and
linseed oil is strong, as if the work had been done only this morning.
The wards dim near the benches. Aisles lead north, east and south, and
an opening west gives onto the ward.

12342.name: The Workshop

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12342.description:
The workshop opens here onto the Inner Ward through a wide archway where
wagons once rolled in. Heavy chains and pulleys hang from a beam for
hoisting, and ruts are worn deep in the floor. The ward-light slants in
across the threshold. The workshop runs north and east, the stable lies
south, and west the arch opens on the ward.

12343.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Workshop.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Stable.

12343.description:
The stable's central aisle is a broad avenue of packed earth where the
stalls meet the workshop. A lantern hangs from a hook without a flame,
yet it gives off a steady cold light. Chaff drifts in the air and never
settles. Ways lead north to the workshop, east and south among the
stalls, and west toward the ward.

12344.name: The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To The Keep.

12344.description:
A stable yard of rough cobbles, with the hitching posts still standing
in a row and the water pump seized solid. Horse brasses hang from a
nail, black with tarnish. The smell of straw is old and sour. A passage
leads north to the ward, east among the stalls, south to a further
stable, and west to the pathway.

12345.name: Pathway To The Keep

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies On the Castle Grounds.

west.description: To the west lies Servants Quarters.

12345.description:
A broad flagged way runs toward the keep between two rows of iron posts
topped with dead lanterns. The stones are worn into a shallow trench
along the middle, the track of ceaseless marching. The sour smell of old
hay drifts from the stable to the east, and a plain door to the west
leads into the servants' quarters. The way continues north into the
inner ward and south to the castle grounds.

12346.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Centre Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To The Keep.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12346.description:
The Inner Ward spreads out in a great paved court, hemmed in by columns
of grey stone and roofed by shimmering ward-light. A row of statues
stands along its edge, each a warden of the castle, each with a
different name on the plinth and all with the same worn stone face. The
hum of the wards is louder here, and loose paving trembles slightly
underfoot. The centre ward lies north, passages lead east and west, and
the pathway runs back south.

12347.name: The Centre Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Ward.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

down.description: To the down lies The Sacrificial Altar.

12347.description:
A round dais of black stone marks the centre of the ward, ringed by the
brass sigils of the great warding spell. In its middle an iron grille
stands open on a stair that spirals down into the dark, breathing out a
cold that smells of old blood. The light overhead is brightest here,
white and merciless. Ways lead off in all four directions, and the steps
go down to a sacrificial altar below.

extra_descs.dais sigils brass:
The brass sigils are set in the stone in nine concentric rings, each
ring a different script. The innermost ring is blackened and cracked, as
though the spell it held has been bent to a darker purpose.

12348.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Ward.

west.description: To the west lies The Centre Ward.

12348.description:
A long stone trough stands against the wall here, and a pole for hanging
signal flags rises beside it, its pulley stuck fast. The flags
themselves hang in grey tatters that never stir. Scuffed circles in the
paving show where men once drilled in ranks. The ward goes on north and
south, the centre ward lies west, and a doorway east leads into the
workshop.

12349.name: The Inner Ward

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Ward.

east.description: To the east lies The Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Inner Ward.

12349.description:
Two cartwheels lie sunk in a gouge of the paving, as if a wagon once
collapsed here and was dragged away. A bell hangs in a stone frame,
cracked clean through and silent. The air is dry and tastes of rust. The
ward runs north and west, a doorway east opens into the workshop, and
the stable lies south.

12350.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

12350.description:
Here the gallery's outer wall is lined with arrow-slits cut at angles
for archers, and a row of oil-stained niches holds iron braziers gone
cold. Beneath each slit the floor is polished by the pacing of watchers.
The ward-sigils glow a sullen red rather than blue. The gallery
continues east toward the entrance and west around the wall.

12351.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend Around The Castle.

12351.description:
A pair of massive buttresses squeeze the gallery here, leaving only a
narrow gap between them where the stone is bright with scraping, as of
plate armour pushing through. A smell of oil and old blood hangs about
the place. The ward-hum has deepened to a growl. The way runs east
toward the entrance and west around a bend.

12352.name: A Bend Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

12352.description:
The gallery bends here in a tight curve and then stops, closed by a wall
of mortared stone newer than the rest. Chisel marks scar it where
someone tried to dig through from the other side. The ward-sigils flare
angrily and the hum turns to a whine. There is nothing here but the way
back east.

12354.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies Around the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

12354.description:
The vault is lower here, and the stone sweats pale beads that glow where
they catch the ward-light. A rack bolted to the wall holds nothing now
but a few rotted straps. Grooves are worn down the middle of the
flagstones, as if a column of soldiers has marched this gallery day and
night for a very long time. You can follow the curve east or west.

12355.name: Around the Warded Castle

east.description: To the east lies A Bend Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

12355.description:
Faded murals of a siege cover the walls, painted by someone who loved
the soldiers in them; every face has since been scratched out. Cold
flows along the gallery from the east, where it bends away out of sight.
A sconce hangs empty, its bracket twisted as though something strong
once wrenched at it. West the passage runs back toward the entrance.

12356.name: A Bend Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Warded Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Warded Castle.

12356.description:
The gallery makes a sharp turn here around a buttress of dressed stone,
its face scored with thousands of tally marks in neat rows of five.
Ward-light pulses in the cracks with a slow, patient rhythm, like a
sleeper's breath. The passage climbs a gentle ramp north, while the long
run of the wall lies back west.

12357.name: Around the Warded Castle

north.description: To the north lies Around the Warded Castle.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend Around The Castle.

12357.description:
The passage narrows until two men could barely pass abreast, with the
outer wall pressing close on one side. Someone has chalked the same word
again and again at head height: Stay. The air smells of iron and of old,
cold wax. The way goes on north, and south it returns to the bend.

12358.name: Around the Warded Castle

north.description: To the north lies A Pile of Rubble.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Warded Castle.

12358.description:
Cracks have crept across the vault, and fine grit sifts onto your
shoulders with every footstep. The ward-sigils here are blackened and
dim, their hum broken into a stuttering whine. Splinters of a wooden
brace lie wedged in the floor joints, rotted soft as bread. Ahead north
the passage is cluttered with fallen stone, and south it leads back the
way you came.

12359.name: A Pile of Rubble

south.description: To the south lies Around the Warded Castle.

12359.description:
A section of the vault has come down, burying the gallery under a hill
of broken blocks and splintered beams. Above the slope a ragged hole
shows where a ward-stone burst, leaving a scorched ring in the ceiling
that still smells of lightning. Dust trickles from the heap in the
silence. Nothing remains open but the passage south.

12360.name: Inside the Warded Keep

north.description: To the north lies On the Spiral Staircase.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Warded Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To The Keep.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12360.description:
You are in the keep's great entrance hall, a lofty chamber whose ribbed
ceiling disappears in the shifting glow of the wards. Torn banners of
the old garrison hang from iron rods, so faded that their colours are
only rumour. Ahead north the floor rises to the foot of a spiral
staircase, and lesser halls open east and west. Behind you south, the
doorway gives onto the pathway.

12361.name: Inside the Warded Keep

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12361.description:
Rows of soldiers' cots fill this corner, their straw ticks gone to brown
dust and their blankets rotted to webs. Footprints in the dust circle
the room over and over in the same worn track. A mouldering cloak hangs
forgotten from a peg. Passages lead north and east.

12362.name: Inside the Warded Keep

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12362.description:
A small guard room opens at the keep's corner, with a plank table set
with dice and a candle stub that burns without ever shrinking. Pegs for
cloaks line the wall, and one rusted hauberk hangs from them still. A
slit window shows only the white wash of the wards. The passage leads
north, and west to the entrance hall.

12363.name: Inside the Warded Keep

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Warded Keep.

west.description: To the west lies On the Spiral Staircase.

12363.description:
A narrow hall of whitewashed stone runs along the base of the stair,
lined with iron-bound chests whose lids have been hacked open and left
empty. Scratches mark the walls at shoulder height, as of fingers
dragged across the plaster. The wards hum thinly here. Halls continue
north and south, and the staircase is west.

12364.name: Inside the Warded Keep

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Warded Keep.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12364.description:
A cold hearth big enough to roast an ox gapes in the wall of this corner
room, its stones black with the soot of countless fires. Above it hangs
a boar's head, mouldered to a leathery mask. Split logs lie stacked
beside it, gone grey as driftwood. Passages lead south and west.

12365.name: Inside the Warded Keep

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Warded Keep.

south.description: To the south lies On the Spiral Staircase.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12365.description:
A long banquet table, bare of any feast, stretches across this hall, its
top deeply scored by knives and fists. High-backed chairs stand around
it, all pushed back as if the diners had risen at once in alarm. Dusty
tapestries of the hunt hang between narrow slits that show only a white
glimmer. The stair is south, with the hall running on east and west.

12368.name: Inside the Warded Keep

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Warded Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12368.description:
Shelves of a once-fine library line this corner, but the books are fused
into black, curled masses, as if lightning had struck within. Burn marks
stripe the floor in a ring around a reading desk. The smell of scorched
vellum still lingers in the air. A passage leads east, and another
south.

12369.name: Inside the Warded Keep

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

east.description: To the east lies On the Spiral Staircase.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Warded Keep.

12369.description:
A small chapel of the ward fills this hall, with a stone altar bearing a
silver sigil in a circle of cut crystals that glitter with blue light.
Kneeling benches face it, the cushions long rotted, and carved prayers
for lasting watchfulness cover the walls. The stair lies east, with
halls leading north and south.

12370.name: On the Spiral Staircase

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Warded Keep.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Warded Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Warded Keep.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Warded Keep.

up.description: To the up lies Climbing the Spiral Staircase.

12370.description:
A spiral staircase of pale stone winds up through the centre of the
keep, its steps worn in the middle to shallow bowls. A rail of black
iron follows the curve, polished by the palms of ten thousand climbers.
Halls open in every direction from the foot of the stair, and the hum of
the wards runs up the stone like a pulse in a throat. Above, the steps
rise into dimness.

12371.name: Climbing the Spiral Staircase

up.description: To the up lies Climbing the Spiral Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies On the Spiral Staircase.

12371.description:
The spiral staircase climbs on, its narrow steps turning tight around a
central pillar. The outer wall is pierced by slit windows that show a
flat white glow instead of any view. The hum of the wards is fainter
here and the cold sharper. The stair winds up to a higher landing, or
down to the keep's hall.

12376.name: Climbing the Spiral Staircase

up.description: To the up lies The Top of the Keep.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing the Spiral Staircase.

12376.description:
Higher yet the stair steepens, and the pillar at its heart is carved
with a spiral of tiny runes that bleed blue light. Dust lies in an
unbroken skin on every step but the edges, where boots have worn a
groove. The air tastes of metal. Up lies the top of the keep, and down
the winding steps.

12381.name: The Top of the Keep

north.description: To the north lies A White Room.

east.description: To the east lies A White Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Destroyed Hall.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing the Spiral Staircase.

12381.description:
The stair ends in a round chamber crowned by a domed vault, where the
great ward-stone of the castle turns slowly, shedding blue light across
a floor of cracked marble. A tablet of bronze set into the wall carries
the oath of the garrison and, beneath it, a curse. Pale doorways stand
to the north and east, and a door of splintered oak leads south into a
ruined hall. The stair winds down.

extra_descs.tablet bronze oath curse:
The oath is cut in a soldier's blunt letters: to hold the castle until
relieved, living or dead. The curse beneath it is in finer script, and
its last line reads that relief shall never come.

12382.name: A Destroyed Hall

west.description: To the west lies A Destroyed Hall.

north.description: To the north lies The Top of the Keep.

12382.description:
Once a feasting hall, this is a ruin: the roof beams have fallen, the
great table has been smashed to kindling, and scorched stone shows where
a fierce fire raged. Strange black glass crusts parts of the walls,
fused by a heat no hearth could make. The ward-light is ragged and torn,
flaring in patches. A broken door in one wall leads on west.

extra_descs.glass black walls:
The black glass is smooth and cold, and in its depths you see a glimmer
of white wings. It may be a trick of the ward-light.

12383.name: A White Room

south.description: To the south lies The Top of the Keep.

12383.description:
White plaster covers every surface of this small chamber, floor and
ceiling alike, without joint or crack. A cold radiance with no source
fills it, so that nothing casts a shadow, not even you. The ward-hum
here has narrowed to a single pure note that makes the ears ring. There
is no door, no window, and no sign of how the room is meant to be left.

12384.name: A White Room

west.description: To the west lies The Top of the Keep.

12384.description:
The walls of this white chamber are scratched with countless fine
tallies, row on row, as though someone counted days here for an age. The
air is still and carries a faint, dry smell of chalk. A glimmer of ward-
light creeps along the ceiling and never quite arrives anywhere. Nothing
about the smooth plaster offers a way out.

12385.name: A Destroyed Hall

north.description: To the north lies A Destroyed Hall.

east.description: To the east lies A Destroyed Hall.

12385.description:
The ruin continues in a gallery of collapsed arches, choked with rubble
and the twisted remains of iron chandeliers. A cold wind from nowhere
stirs the dust into slow spirals. A mural of an angel with broken wings
has been half-effaced on the wall, and what remains weeps long streaks
of soot. A door in the hall leads north.

12386.name: A Destroyed Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Fallen Angel's Prison.

south.description: To the south lies A Destroyed Hall.

12386.description:
The last of the destroyed hall is a narrow antechamber, its floor
cracked and inlaid with a ring of silver that has melted in places.
Feathers of pale light drift down from a hole in the ceiling and fade
before they touch the stone. The air hums with sorrow rather than
threat. A strong iron door bound with ward-chains leads north.

12387.name: The Fallen Angel's Prison

south.description: To the south lies A Destroyed Hall.

12387.description:
A small round chamber, its walls studded with silver chains set deep in
the stone and its floor etched with a cage of ward-sigils. Black
feathers each as long as a forearm lie scattered about, and they do not
stir in any draught. The silence is complete; even the hum of the
castle's wards seems held at bay. The iron door has sealed behind you,
and nothing here suggests a way out.

extra_descs.chains silver feathers:
The silver chains are fixed with bolts the width of a wrist. The
feathers beneath them are warm to the touch and smell faintly of rain.

12388.name: The Sacrificial Altar

up.description: To the up lies The Centre Ward.

12388.description:
A low chamber of fitted black stone lies below the ward, its floor
channelled and stained dark. At its heart stands the sacrificial altar,
a slab of grey granite with iron rings set at its corners. Stale candles
ring the room in clots of old wax, and the walls are scored with tally
marks and prayers for mercy. The ward-hum here is a hollow groan, and
the only way out is the stair up to the centre ward.

extra_descs.altar granite rings:
The granite is smoothed by years of use, and the iron rings are polished
bright by straining wrists. In the dark channel beneath, a fresh drip of
red gleams, though no one has come here for years.

652000.name: soldier cursed garrison undying
652000.short_desc: a cursed soldier of the garrison
652000.long_desc: A cursed soldier of the garrison trudges his rounds, his grey face blank and his sword already drawn.
652000.description:
The soldier's tabard bears the faded badge of the castle, and the flesh
under his helm has the colour of candle wax. Wounds that should have
killed him gape unbleeding, and he fights on without a word.

652001.name: cook cursed kitchen servant
652001.long_desc: A cursed cook shuffles between the pots, stirring a cauldron that has been cold for years.
652001.description:
The cook is a stout figure in a stained apron, his eyes milk-white and
his hands blackened to the wrist. He turns a heavy cleaver idly and
grins without humour.

652002.name: ogre mould fungus hulking
652002.long_desc: A mould-ridden ogre lumbers between the beds, pale caps sprouting from its shoulders.
652002.description:
Thick white fungus crawls over the ogre's hide, and spores puff from its
mouth with every breath. It tends the beds in a slow stupor, but it sets
upon any intruder with huge, clumsy fists.

652003.name: headsman executioner undying hooded
652003.long_desc: An undying headsman stands beside the trapdoor, leaning on a long two-handed axe.
652003.description:
A tall, broad figure in a black leather hood, with only two eyes burning
pale behind the slits. The axe has been sharpened so often its edge is a
hair's thickness, and he has not forgotten how to swing it.

652004.name: knight ward warded armoured revenant
652004.long_desc: A ward-bound knight paces the hall in full plate, blue light seeping from every seam of his armour.
652004.description:
Runes burn along the knight's breastplate and the edges of his tower
shield. Inside the helm there is only a cold, bright glow, and the
armour moves with the stiffness of a statue pushed by a will not its
own.

652005.name: captain hollis unburied guard
652005.long_desc: Captain Hollis, the Unburied Captain, stands at his table, calling the roll of a garrison that cannot die.
652005.description:
The captain's armour is polished and his moustache neatly waxed, but the
face below it is the grey of tallow and his chest is crossed by a dozen
old wounds. His voice is calm, courteous and quite without mercy.

652006.name: warden cursed lord hadrec
652006.long_desc: Hadrec Vael, the cursed Warden, stands beneath the ward-stone with both hands on the hilt of his sword.
652006.description:
The Warden is a tall man in black plate, crowned with an iron circlet
fused to his brow. His eyes blaze with the blue of the ward-stone, and
wherever his boots fall the floor cracks. He is the one who made the
curse, and the one it will not let rest.

752000.name: sword garrison blade pitted
752000.room_desc: A pitted garrison sword lies here.
752000.description: A soldier's straight sword, its edge notched and its fuller etched with a small warding rune. The grip is wound with cord worn smooth by many hands.

752001.name: axe headsman executioner
752001.room_desc: A long-hafted headsman's axe lies here.
752001.description: A heavy axe with a broad, crescent blade, honed to a hair's edge. The haft is dark with the sweat of one long career.

752002.name: shield tower ward knight runed
752002.room_desc: A runed tower shield lies here, faintly aglow.
752002.description: A tall shield of dark steel, its face etched with spiralling runes that glow blue when struck. It is heavy but wonderfully balanced.

752003.name: cuirass captain breastplate plate
752003.room_desc: A polished steel cuirass lies here.
752003.description: A fine steel breastplate, still bright, with a castle badge embossed over the heart. A dozen small dents and one long scar mark where it has turned aside the blows of years.

752004.name: signet ring warden iron blue
752004.room_desc: A heavy iron signet ring glints blue on the floor.
752004.description: A broad iron ring with a sapphire-coloured stone set in the bezel. Looking into the stone, you see a tiny, tireless figure walking the walls of a castle.
